title: turn_offer
description: Phone to hub, with the `corpus` capability: one Turn of the phone's Corpus, offered for upload. The hub answers `turn_ack`: `stored` when it already holds this Turn (a re-upload is a no-op), `send` to ask for the Recording, or `rejected`. The phone has at most one Turn on offer at a time.

turn.description: The Turn's directory name, `<started_at>-<id>` (docs/phase0.md, "Corpus format"): unique, where a 6-hex id is not. The Turn's identity for the upload, and the directory name the hub stores it under.

turn_json.description: The Turn's `turn.json`, its whole text exactly as the phone wrote it. The hub stores it byte for byte (UTF-8). It must parse as a JSON object; its `audio.file` names the Recording's file (`audio.wav` when absent).

audio.description: The Recording the phone will send, as it read it: what the hub checks the received bytes against.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the whole file.
